original_question_en: If local subgraphs have large independent sets, must the whole graph be close to bipartite after few modifications?
underlying_problem: Erdos Problems #73 (https://www.erdosproblems.com/73), solved by B. Reed, 'Mangoes and Blueberries', Combinatorica (1999), 267-296.
formal_statement: Let k >= 0 and let G be a finite graph such that every subgraph H of G has an independent set of size at least (|V(H)| - k)/2. Then for every k there is f(k) such that deleting at most f(k) vertices leaves G bipartite.
lean_statement_of_record: JSP90.Erdős73 (k : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ m, Erdős73On k m, with LocIndep and CloseToBipartite in lean/JSPProblem/Definitions.lean
